central-africa.title: Afrika ya Kati
central-africa.description: JK Kongo, Kameruni, Chad, Jamhuri ya Afrika ya Kati, Gabon, Kongo, Guinea ya Ikweta, Angola na Zambia — Kinshasa, Luanda, Douala, Yaoundé, N'Djamena, Lusaka; bonde la mto Kongo, Bonde la Ufa la Albertine.

east-africa.title: Afrika Mashariki
east-africa.description: Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Ethiopia, Rwanda, Burundi, Somalia na Sudan Kusini — Nairobi, Dar es Salaam, Addis Ababa, Kampala, Kigali, Mombasa, Zanzibar, Mlima Kilimanjaro, Serengeti na Ziwa Victoria.

horn-of-africa.title: Pembe ya Afrika
horn-of-africa.description: Ethiopia, Somalia, Eritrea, Jibuti, Sudan Kusini na kaskazini mwa Kenya — Addis Ababa, Mogadishu, Asmara, Jiji la Jibuti, Juba; nyanda za juu za Ethiopia, Bonde la Ufa, pwani ya Bahari ya Shamu.

south-central-us.title: Kusini-Kati mwa Marekani
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi na Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson na Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa na Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, Samoa ya Marekani, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau, na Wallis na Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi na Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila na visiwa vya Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam na Visiwa vya Mariana ya Kaskazini
mariana-islands.description: Guam na Visiwa vya Mariana ya Kaskazini — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian na Rota.

greenland.title: Grinlandi
greenland.description: Grinlandi — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq na Tasiilaq; tabaka la barafu, Fyord ya Barafu ya Ilulissat na fyord za kusini.

bermuda.title: Bermuda
bermuda.description: Bermuda — Hamilton, St. George’s na Royal Naval Dockyard, parokia za kisiwa na fukwe zake za mchanga wa waridi.

belarus.title: Belarusi
belarus.description: Belarusi — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno na Brest; msitu wa Belovezhskaya Pushcha na mabwawa ya Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Visiwa vya Channel
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark na Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port na Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Visiwa vya Faroe
faroe-islands.description: Visiwa vya Faroe — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík na visiwa kumi na nane, vijiji vyake, mahandaki na majabali ya pwani.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard na Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg na Ny-Ålesund; barafuto na fyord za Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo na Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria na Miji Mitatu.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagaska na Visiwa vya Bahari ya Hindi
madagascar-islands.description: Madagaska, Komoro, Mayotte, Réunion, Morisi na Shelisheli — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis na Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Sudan — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid na Nyala; makutano ya Naili ya Buluu na Naili Nyeupe na piramidi za Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Cabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Cabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria na visiwa kumi, kuanzia Santo Antão hadi Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé na Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé na Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António na misitu ya mvua na fukwe za visiwa hivyo viwili.

saint-helena.title: Santa Helena, Ascension na Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Santa Helena, Kisiwa cha Ascension na Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown na Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladeshi
bangladesh.description: Bangladeshi — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet na Cox’s Bazar; Sundarbans na delta ya Ganges–Brahmaputra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka na Maldivi
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka na Maldivi — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura na Malé; nyanda za juu, Sigiriya na visiwa vya tumbawe.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Vietnam — Hanoi, Jiji la Ho Chi Minh, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An na Can Tho; Ghuba ya Ha Long na Delta ya Mekong.

philippines.title: Ufilipino
philippines.description: Ufilipino — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio na Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao na Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonesia na Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: Indonesia na Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar na Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi na Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malaysia, Singapuri na Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malaysia, Singapuri na Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapuri, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching na Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine na Ziwa Inle; bonde la Irrawaddy na vilima vya Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Kambodia na Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Kambodia na Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap na Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang na Pakse; mto Mekong na Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Kolombia
colombia.description: Kolombia — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena na Bucaramanga; milima ya Andes, pwani ya Karibi na Amazon.

venezuela.title: Venezuela
venezuela.description: Venezuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida na Ciudad Bolívar; Maporomoko ya Angel, mto Orinoco na Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos na Puno; Machu Picchu, Ziwa Titicaca na Bonde Takatifu.

ecuador.title: Ekwado
ecuador.description: Ekwado — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta na Baños; Njia ya Volkano, Amazon na Visiwa vya Galápagos.

bolivia.title: Bolivia
bolivia.description: Bolivia — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre na Potosí; Ziwa Titicaca na Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Chile
chile.description: Chile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena na Punta Arenas; jangwa la Atacama, Eneo la Maziwa, Patagonia na Kisiwa cha Pasaka.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paragwai na Urugwai
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paragwai na Urugwai — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este na Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Guiana
guianas.description: Guyana, Surinamu na Guiana ya Kifaransa — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne na Kourou; Maporomoko ya Kaieteur na msitu wa mvua wa Ngao ya Guiana.

falklands.title: Visiwa vya Falkland
falklands.description: Visiwa vya Falkland — Stanley, Goose Green na visiwa vya Falkland Mashariki na Falkland Magharibi.

australia.title: Australia
australia.description: Australia — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin na Canberra; Mwamba Mkuu wa Tumbawe, Uluru na Outback.

new-zealand.title: Nyuzilandi
new-zealand.description: Nyuzilandi — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin na Queenstown; Milima ya Alpi ya Kusini, Fiordland na Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George na Whistler; Milima ya Pwani, Kisiwa cha Vancouver na Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Nyanda za Kanada
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan na Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina na Banff; Milima ya Rocky, nyanda na Churchill kwenye Ghuba ya Hudson.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston na Thunder Bay; Maporomoko ya Niagara, Maziwa Makuu na Hifadhi ya Algonquin.

quebec.title: Quebec
quebec.description: Quebec — Montréal, Jiji la Quebec, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke na Saguenay; mto St. Lawrence, milima ya Laurentian na Rasi ya Gaspé.

atlantic-canada.title: Kanada ya Atlantiki
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, na Newfoundland na Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton na Charlottetown; Cabot Trail na Ghuba ya Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Kaskazini mwa Kanada
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Maeneo ya Kaskazini-Magharibi na Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City na Inuvik; Funguvisiwa la Aktiki na mto Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong na Makau
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong na Makau — Kisiwa cha Hong Kong, Kowloon, New Territories, Lantau na Rasi ya Makau, Taipa na Coloane.
